points.description: Names one valid environmental problem of open dumping, e.g. leachate generation/groundwater or water contamination, GHG/methane release, odour, or insect/rodent infestation causing health problems.
Names a second, different valid environmental problem from the same set (leachate/water pollution, GHG/methane/air emissions, odour, insects and rodents/public health).

rubric.notes: Award 1 mark for each distinct valid problem from the model answer, in any wording (e.g. 'groundwater pollution' for leachate, 'methane/bad gases' for GHGs, 'smell' for odour, 'flies/rats/disease' for pests). Two correct different problems earn 2; one earns 1; none earns 0. Do not penalise wrong extra remarks, but do not give two marks for the same problem worded twice.
